Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this on. We're planning a tabletop and a hands-on simulation for our BYOK private deployment and need a focused DR playbook from Redwood that covers the following high-level scenarios:

- Full HSM hardware failure in primary region (unrecoverable device)
- Operator machine compromise (potential exposure of wrapped KEK)
- Accidental key deletion / mistaken rotation during maintenance
- Cross-region failover with wrapped key export/import

Can you provide a short runbook that lists activation criteria, operator actions, required artifacts (sealed key backups, attestation logs), and expected RTO/RPO assumptions? Also please call out the minimum personnel quorum for any manual key-unwrapping steps and the audit/evidence we can expect to collect during recovery.

Attachment: acme_kms_requirements.pdf (our security team sketched constraints)

We'd like to run a simulation the week of Sep 21. Let us know availability and any prework.

Best,
Alice Porter

FWIW, adding a technical sketch here that I’ll include in the playbook appendix. High-level recovery outline: 

1) Detection & activation
   - Activation criteria: HSM unresponsive > 15m + hardware tamper flag OR manual declaration by custodian with CEO-level approval (per Acme policy).

2) Initial containment
   - Isolate affected host VLAN and revoke ephemeral operator keys.
   - Snapshot audit logs (KV cache and KMS audit) to WORM storage.

3) Key recovery paths (ordered)
   A) Restore from sealed-key backup (preferred) — unwrap with pre-shared unseal parts (3-of-5 quorum).
   B) If sealed backup not usable: use spare HSM in DR region + wrapped KEK import (requires attestation and embargoed transfer).
   C) Last resort: emergency key material reconstruction — manual multi-party key ceremony with tamper-evident custody.

4) Rotation & verification
   - Post-restore rotate session keys and KEK, reconcile token signatures, run regression prompts against a canary prompt set.

5) Evidence collection
   - HSM attestation statements, signed key-ceremony receipts, system snapshots, and our standard signed audit bundle.

Notes: need to confirm whether Acme allows outbound wrapped-key export under your transport encryption rules. If not, we’ll base the playbook on pre-staged sealed backups only.

Attachment: hsm_failover_flow.png (diagram)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxy/ACME-DR

-Marissa
Principal Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

- Operator on-call access: we need explicit windows and MFA-backed bastion access for any unwrapping event. Is the manual unwrapping command only accessible from operator bastion with YubiKey/HSM-protected SSH?
- Tamper evidence: we need the HSM attestation chain and signed firmware hash for any imported device; retention for attestations must be 3 years.

Also attaching a short list of additional questions (Attachment: acme_security_questions.docx).

Can Redwood confirm the evidence bundle format and whether you can produce the signed audit bundle within 24h of a declared event?

Best,
Alice

Hi Alice — attached is a consolidated draft: DR_Playbook_v1.docx. Key points: 

- Activation: defined thresholds and an emergency declaration flow (see section 1).
- Access control: operator unwrapping requires bastion access + hardware 2FA + recorded video evidence; we propose a 3-person quorum (2 Acme custodians + 1 Redwood operations witness) for KEK unwrapping.
- Evidence & SLA: Redwood will provide a signed audit bundle within 24h of activation (attestations, system snapshots, signed receipts). We capture non-repudiation artifacts in the appendix.
- RTO/RPO: target RTO for key recovery = 2 hours (assumes sealed backup in S3+KMS and pre-approved cross-region export). RPO = N/A for keys (we rely on sealed backups).
- Simulation: propose a full recovery drill on Sep 23 (hands-on) and a tabletop on Sep 22.

Please review sections 2.1 (key ceremony) and 3.2 (operator actions) closely. If Acme cannot permit wrapped-key export, we will adjust RTO assumptions and note manual reconstruction as the fallback.

Attachment: dr_playbook_v1.docx
Related JIRA: KMS-4821
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxy/ACME-DR

Thanks — I’ll open the Jira ticket and propose the calendar invites after I get your confirmation on the quorum and export policy.
